whatsappMessage:
Hi Om Vihar Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has a strong presence with 778 reviews in Kadamkuan, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for direct table bookings and takeaway orders.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp menu ordering, opening hours, aur customer reviews integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/omvihar

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Om Vihar Restaurant team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp menu ordering, mobile-first speed, and highlighting your Kadamkuan location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
